tips: Myeloid DC subsetting by CD1c (BDCA-1). As labeled in this file: mDC1 = CD1c+, mDC2 = CD1c-. Nomenclature caveat: in the canonical cDC1 / cDC2 convention, cDC1 = CD141+ (BDCA-3+) cross-presenting DCs and cDC2 = CD1c+ (BDCA-1+) inflammatory DCs — so the CD1c+ subset is conventionally cDC2, not cDC1. The label mapping in this panel (CD1c+ → mDC1) appears inverted relative to the canonical convention; whether this is intentional (lab-specific naming) or an error should be verified with the panel author. CD141 is not in this panel, so a true cDC1 gate cannot be established.
